entries.what: Linh works Heron & Grind noon to 6 pulling shots; Wes comes in for his cortado and she restocks oat milk before the college term starts.
entries.outcome: Shift ran smoothly and the cafe was quiet.

entries.what: Evening at home on Pell Road: Linh lays out her planner with washi tape and sorts new pens and highlighters for tomorrow.
entries.outcome: Planner set up for the first week.

entries.what: Hạnh leaves a plate on the table after closing Lotus Nails; Linh eats late and goes to bed around 12:30.
First day of Tamsen Valley fall term: Linh fights for parking-lot space near Lot C and gets syllabi for anatomy, chemistry and statistics.
entries.outcome: Collected all three syllabi, Lot C was chaos.

entries.what: General Chemistry at 11 a.m., then lunch skipped while she copies due dates from all syllabi into one list.
entries.outcome: All first-week deadlines in one place; forgot to eat.

entries.what: At night she asks her assistant to merge the syllabi into a single hour-blocked weekly schedule, then color-codes it to match her notes (pink muscles, blue bones).
entries.outcome: Finished an hour-by-hour schedule she pins above her desk.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Dr. Okoye; Linh sits next to Rochelle, who asks questions fearlessly. Heat wave begins and the classroom is stuffy.
entries.outcome: Got through the first lecture on anatomical terms.

entries.what: Works Heron & Grind noon to 6; the cafe is packed with people escaping 100-degree heat and iced cortados sell out.
Bikes home in the evening heat and reviews flashcards from her 600-card anatomy deck before bed.
Hot ride to campus for 11 a.m. General Chemistry; Kenji gives her a ride home afterward since it is a Thursday.
Studies at the Alcaraz Flats library, which is open as a cooling center, working on stats homework online.
Thao texts about a phở breakfast after her night shift; Linh says maybe later and puts it off.
Anatomy at 9 a.m.; Dr. Okoye warns the class that a third of every section fails the lab practicals.
entries.outcome: Linh underlines the warning in her notes.

entries.what: Skips lunch again and sketches her stats notes in the library, then goes home to a cold plate from Hạnh.
Quick check-in with Kenji by text about his transfer plans and her own doubts about nursing.
entries.outcome: Kept it short; she admitted only a little.

entries.what: Saturday opening shift at Heron & Grind starting 6:30; heat wave keeps customers lingering with iced drinks, and Jun shows her another milk-pouring tip.
entries.outcome: Got through the rush; practiced pouring a heart.

entries.what: Afternoon at the library cooling center reviewing bones with her blue highlighter.
Eats a bowl of bún bò Huế at home with Hạnh, who avoids bringing up pharmacy.
Sunday opening shift at Heron & Grind, 6:30 to 1, in the continuing heat.
Helps at the Lotus Nails front desk from 2 to 5, answering phones and booking appointments for Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Hạnh bragged about her latte art to a customer.

entries.what: Sunday night she plans next week in her washi-tape planner, blocking study and shifts.
